mainEntity.name: How does Flipick create product videos for Shopify stores?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flipick connects to your Shopify catalog and renders one master AI film per product type. That master is then versioned — with your live prices, SKU names and overlays — using Variable Video Production (VVP), so every SKU gets its own current video without re-rendering on AI.

mainEntity.name: How many product videos can Flipick produce from one master film?

acceptedAnswer.text: One master film can become hundreds of variants — one per SKU, size, colour, price tier or market. Each variant is rendered on Flipick's servers at a fraction of the master's cost, so a catalog of 800 products can have current video without a proportional budget.

mainEntity.name: Does the video stay current when my Shopify prices change?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because prices are injected as overlay data rather than baked into the AI render, updating a price means re-rendering only the overlay layer — not the underlying film. This keeps catalog videos current at minimal cost.

Flipick's Shopify catalog video service is designed for US-based Shopify brands and agencies that manage large product catalogs and need video at scale — without per-video production budgets or manual editing cycles.
